source_basis.prior_frontier: Resolve the persistent Buildkite failure before advancing the forge pointer.

failure_pattern_attacked: The durable pointer attributed the unresolved CI contradiction to freshness work, but provider history showed the first red commit was 96e84e78e11c40ede2486d18feed48320d8559e9, which added a host-only dynamic-skills test that asserted ~/bin/skills must exist on every repository CI runner. That conflated absence of an Operator-host integration with repository failure and kept every later Buildkite build red.
durable_changes: Changed tests/test_dynamic_skills_ctl.py from an unconditional repository test into an explicit host-integration test.
Missing or non-executable ~/bin/skills now produces unittest.SkipTest rather than a false repository failure.
Added GLACIEREQ_SKILLS_BIN override so an authorized host/runtime can bind the test to its actual executable path.
Replaced PEP-604 return annotation syntax with typing.Tuple/Any to reduce unpinned-Python CI compatibility risk.

verification.provider_readback: tests/test_dynamic_skills_ctl.py at repair commit has blob 01ee07ac631fea57f48bd8463818bdf5c8b71b2d

counterevidence_and_constraints: Remote Desktop Commander had no connected device during this run, so no claim is made about current Operator-host ~/bin/skills health.
The Buildkite repair proves portable repository CI is restored; it does not prove the skipped host integration itself passes on an Operator machine.
Container git clone had no network resolution, so provider-native GitHub state and commit-status history were used as the alternate evidence path.

objective_state_delta.before: Freshness/runtime work was implemented but every later Buildkite status remained red, and the durable pointer mislocalized the regression to the freshness frontier.
objective_state_delta.after: The actual regression introduction is provider-bisected to the host-only test commit, the test is portable without weakening host execution when available, and Buildkite is green again on the repair commit.

next_executable_frontier: Separate host-runtime verification from portable repository CI explicitly: add a deterministic host-integration contract/test lane that requires GLACIEREQ_SKILLS_BIN when intentionally invoked, while generic CI verifies that host-only tests skip rather than fail when the capability is absent; then verify both paths on the next available Operator host and preserve both receipts.
